description: Adds a cover image to a draft press release. Send an image URL, or a file the user attached in the chat. With neither, it returns a one-time upload link where the user can drop the image. An image 1200 px wide or more fills the page, and from 600 px it shows at its own size. Under 600 px, or without an image, the release uses a simple cover with the company logo and headline, so this step is optional.

image_file.description: A file the user attached in the chat.

image_is_ai.description: true when the image was made with AI. The page then labels it "Illustration, created with AI".

image_url.description: A public https URL of the image.

name: add_image
title: Add a cover image
